promise: Where could this car take your future?

avoid: recreating any real time-travel movie, its vehicle, light-trail design or characters

cinematography.pacing: builds from still to fast to serene
cinematography.camera: POV and close-ups early, fast push-in for the transition, wide serene frames after
cinematography.lighting: flat grey present, warm light rising from the dash, brilliant streaks, then golden open world
cinematography.color_palette: grey present, warm amber dash glow, cool streaking light, golden future

beats.name: Ordinary moment
beats.goal: Customer stuck in a grey ordinary present. Rain, traffic, waiting.

beats.name: The spark
beats.goal: The dashboard glows to life. A pulse of light. Wait, what?
beats.camera_hint: slow push-in toward the glowing dash, 35mm

beats.name: The impossible
beats.goal: The street stretches and blurs into streaks of light as the world bends forward around the car.

beats.name: Mastery
beats.goal: The car glides into a bright open world that belongs to the customer's future.
beats.sound_hint: music settling into a confident groove

beats.name: New world / payoff
beats.goal: Car seen cleanly from outside at a breathtaking overlook in the customer's dream future. Tagline.
beats.camera_hint: pull-back reveal + slow crane up, wide 24mm
